description: This Java source file defines a BroadcastReceiver class `CustomLocaleReceiver` that listens for a specific intent action to change the system locale dynamically. It processes the incoming intent, validates the locale string, and triggers a locale change via `ChangeLocale.changeSystemLocale()`.

classes.name: CustomLocaleReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that changes the system's locale based on received intents.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the received broadcast intent, validates the locale, and invokes the locale change if valid.
